family: For every integer n>=0, f_n(x)=1 exactly when the n-bit binary string x contains a 1; f_0(empty)=0. One fixed verifier accepts exactly empty witnesses and strings containing a 1, with witness bound W(n)=0.
theorem: For this fixed total uniform P family (hence in NP), C_B2(f_n)=n-1 for every n>=1 in the full Li-Yang B2 model. Consequently liminf over every integer input length n of C_B2(f_n)/n = 1.
